_comment: Top-level config for all_code.py -- holds paths to each pipeline stage's own config file, not the stage settings themselves. Each stage documents and owns its own schema (see flake_detection/config.py, grid_preperation/config.py); edit those files' own JSON configs to tune detection/export behavior, edit this file only to point at a different config file entirely.
_comment_provenance: Same stage configs as config/pipeline_config.json (generic orange_flakes_tuned.json + example_config.json x2) -- per the user, TaS2010 IS the material behind the old local flakes/all folder (28 images), just now available as a larger, more complete set (134 images) on the network share. Confirmed by file count match: local flakes/all=28, network TaS2010/Post Exfo=134, a strict-looking superset relationship.
_comment_input_folder: Folder of raw chip images to run the pipeline over. --input_folder on the command line overrides this.
_comment_interactive: Master switch for every stage's own interactive UI (e.g. flake_detection's post-detection review window). False forces them all off regardless of each stage's own config file; True lets each stage's own flag (e.g. flake_detection's interactive_review) decide individually.
